Title: Report and TWD: German Draft Championship: Sabbat or Camarilla

Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
German Draft Championship 2016
Bad Nauheim, Germany
June 26th, 2016
www.vekn.net/event-calendar/event/8411

5 players gathered to crown – after 2 rounds and a final – the new German draft champion.
The VEKN sanctioned draft cube »Sabbat or Camarilla – The Story of Rosamund of Islington« was used.

The results:
1 Rudolf Garski 0 0 4 48
2 Robert Fängler 0 0 1 48
2 Felix Happich 1 4 0 84
2 Ralf Weppner 1 4 0 84
2 Ben Peal 0 2 0 96

Deck lists and details of the cube will follow.
Stay tuned B)

National Coordinator Germany  nc [dot] germany [at] magenta [dot] de

Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
Here are the storyline cards used in the draft cube ...

Rosamund of Islington
Toreador. Camarilla. Cap 7
CEL, PRE, aus, obf, pro
If you control a ready titled Ventrue, Rosamund can burn 1 blood when she announces an undirected action to get +1 stealth (even if the stealth is not yet needed).

Rosamund of Islington (advanced)
Toreador antitribu. Sabbat. Cap 7
CEL, PRE, aus, obf, pro
Rosamund gets +1 strength in combat against a Ventrue and +1 bleed against a Methuselah who controls a ready Ventrue.
[merged: When Rosamund merges, you can search your hand, ash heap or library for an Art Nouveau Necklace and put it on Rosamund.]

Albin
Caitiff. Camarilla. Cap 4
OBF aus
Albin can look at the hand of a Methuselah who controls a Ventrue as a  action. Any titled Ventrue can take control of Albin for the remainder of the turn as a  action that costs 1 blood.

Art Nouveau Necklace
[no cost]
Unique Equipment. Requires a vampire with capacity 6 or more.
Vampires must burn one 1 blood to attempt to block bearer with . Bearer with  can burn 1 blood to get +1 bleed once each action.

Messages.Author: a-e
Messages.Body:
Grats to Rudolf for winning the title of German draft champion!

This tournament is labeled as "National Championship" in calendar, though it should be labeled as "Limited". This is because now the ratings of this tournament are calculated towards participated players constructed rating instead of limited rating.

IMO there should be "Limited National/Continental Championship" format to separate these kind of events from "normal" draft tournaments.

Marko, Prince of Helsinki
